name: Dead Store Elimination
sota: Cooper & Torczon §8.4; Bodik, Gupta & Soffa PLDI 1998
summary: Forward-scan DSE: track last_write_pos[reg], NOP earlier write when overwritten without intervening read. Label/branch/jump clear tracking (basic-block conservative). Side-effecting instructions skipped. Wired after copy_prop, before DCE loop.
